description: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK03 at app/cbl/COCRDSLC.cbl:305 entered with an EMPTY origin, which is the whole of what separates this case from case14: case14 arrives named by the card list and takes the ELSE of both fallback IFs, this case arrives named by nobody and takes the THEN of both. The AID arm is the FIRST arm of the EVALUATE TRUE at :304, so it wins over the WHEN CDEMO-PGM-REENTER arm at :357 that CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT = 1 would otherwise have selected - the two CDEMO-PGM-ENTER arms at :339-340 and :349 do not apply at context 1 - and EVALUATE is ordered and first-match-wins, which is the gate G30 assertion here (rule R7). app/cpy/CSSTRPFY.cpy:34-35 maps DFHPF3 to CCARD-AID-PFK03 and the :291-299 coercion leaves it there, because PFK03 is one of the two AIDs :292-293 accepts, so the IF PFK-INVALID re-set at :297-298 does not fire. :268 takes its ELSE: EIBCALEN is 172, and the second disjunct needs CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to equal LIT-MENUPGM 'COMEN01C' while NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, but LOW-VALUES is not 'COMEN01C' and the context is REENTER in any case - so the 172 bytes split 1-160 into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and 161-172 into the 12-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA of :200-203, exactly as they do for case14. Both fallback tests spell their subject out twice - IF CDEMO-FROM-TRANID EQUAL LOW-VALUES OR CDEMO-FROM-TRANID EQUAL SPACES at :309-310, and the same shape for CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM at :316-317 - and this case carries a DELIBERATELY MIXED empty shape: the tranid is four SPACES and the program is eight LOW-VALUES bytes. One case therefore exercises the SPACES disjunct of the first test and the LOW-VALUES disjunct of the second, and that mixture is also what proves the two IFs are INDEPENDENT - an implementation that computed a single shared 'the origin is empty' condition would still pass a case whose two fields carried the same pattern, and fails this one. LOW-VALUES is binary x'00' and SPACES is 0x20: they are different values, both mean empty here, and neither is JSON null (practice B8). So :311 moves LIT-MENUTRANID into CDEMO-TO-TRANID as CM00 and :318 moves LIT-MENUPGM into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM as COMEN01C - the menu fallback of :179-182, not the CCLI and COCRDLIC echo that :313 and :320 produce for case14. :323-324 then record this screen as the caller, CCDL and COCRDSLC. :326 SET CDEMO-USRTYP-USER TO TRUE is UNCONDITIONAL, so the ADMIN001 operator who arrived with CDEMO-USER-TYPE 'A' leaves with 'U'; app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:27-28 declares those two 88-levels, the downgrade is the source's own behaviour, and it is reproduced and documented rather than corrected (practices B4 and B5). No authorisation check is added either, because the COBOL performs none (practice B6). :327 SET CDEMO-PGM-ENTER leaves CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT at 0 rather than 1 - the exception in this folder, because 1400-SEND-SCREEN is what sets REENTER and it never runs on this arm. :328 moves LIT-THISMAPSET, PIC X(8) VALUE 'COCRDSL ', into CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET, PIC X(7) per COCOM01Y.cpy:44, so the MOVE right-truncates the literal's trailing space to exactly seven bytes, COCRDSL (rule R5); :329 moves LIT-THISMAP into CDEMO-LAST-MAP unchanged at X(7), CCRDSLA. EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at :331-334 becomes nextProgram COMEN01C and nothing more (gate G40): the client issues the follow-up call, there is no server-side forward, no redirect chain and no session affinity, and the whole conversation travels in the payload (rule R6, gate G37). nextMapset and nextMap are deliberately absent, because the arm never reaches 1400-SEND-SCREEN and so never assigns CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET or CCARD-NEXT-MAP in app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy - the targets the client needs are carried by navigation instead, as CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET COCRDSL and CDEMO-LAST-MAP CCRDSLA. Only the 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA accompanies the transfer, never the 2000-byte WS-COMMAREA with the 12-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA trailer that COMMON-RETURN appends at :397-400; that asymmetry between the XCTL and RETURN paths is real and is preserved (practice B5). Nothing else happens. sends is empty because 1000-SEND-MAP is never performed, so 1100-SCREEN-INIT, 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS, 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS and 1400-SEND-SCREEN all stay unreached and no TRNNAMEO, TITLE01O, TITLE02O, CURDATEO, CURTIMEO, PGMNAMEO, ACCTSIDO, CARDSIDO, INFOMSGO or ERRMSGO and no attribute or colour metadata is produced. mapFields names CARDSIDI at exactly the value the inbound commarea carries, because CARDSID is the {cardNum} path variable and the handler binds it into both CARDSID and CDEMO-CARD-NUM before the dispatcher runs, so the URI and the typed field are one value by construction; the PFK03 arm itself neither receives nor reads it, since 1100-RECEIVE-MAP is reached only through 2000-PROCESS-INPUTS, which this arm never performs, so the value survives only by being carried - which is what navigation asserts. expectedWrites is empty and expectedFinalState re-asserts the three seeded CARDDAT rows unchanged, because 9000-READ-DATA never runs: readByCardNumber is not invoked, and readByAccountIdViaAltIndex is not invoked either, since 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT is unreachable dead code whose only two occurrences in the program are its own labels at :779 and :810, so no CARDAIX alternate-index path is opened (gate G45). COMMON-RETURN is not reached, so there is no RETURN TRANSID('CCDL') and the :386-391 IF INPUT-ERROR guard is unreachable from here. The 88-level WS-EXIT-MESSAGE at :136-137 is declared under WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) and never SET anywhere in the program, so it is unreachable dead code preserved unmodelled and expectedMessages is deliberately empty; its literal text is deliberately not reproduced anywhere in this file, because listing it would fabricate an emission the program never makes (practices B1 and B5), and on this arm that is the most tempting error available. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:33, which is this program's own version footer at :886 and the value case01 and case14 carry, so the case stays deterministic (practice B7) even though this path paints no CURDATEO or CURTIMEO at all. The mandated name CardSelectController diverges from the source's own Function header, README.md:L213-231 and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:220 DESCRIPTION(VIEW CARD DETAIL), which all describe a detail view rather than a select; the name is honoured per rule R1 and the divergence is documented rather than corrected (practice B4, register AAP 0.8.4). Gates G32, G35 and G39 have no site here: all nine GO TOs in this program are forward, five to the shared COMMON-RETURN terminal at :348, :356, :363, :369 and :390 and four to paragraph -EXIT labels at :660, :674, :701 and :715, so there is no backward loop to restructure; there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' anywhere in COCRDSLC, whose abend path is the CICS-native HANDLE ABEND at :250 and :871 reaching ABCODE('9999') at :876; and COCRDSL declares no PAGENO field. Rule R4 has no site either - COCRDSLC declares no PIC 9(n)V99 monetary field, so gates G22-G28 have nothing to assert. Every expected value is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/COCRDSLC.cbl, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CSSTRPFY.cpy and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD, cross-checked against the 160-byte commarea layout of 34 + 84 + 12 + 16 + 14, and is never captured from an execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment (AAP 0.7.6, eight verified blockers, risk R-A).
